### ⚠️ IMPORTANT: Preservation of Design Intent (design.md Enterprise Analytics)
When a linter or rule flags an unauthorized or raw color:
- **DO NOT** simply replace it with a random pre-existing variable just to silence the linter.
- **DO**: Use the corporate blue semantic tokens registered in global CSS (src/index.css): Dark Navy (#0F172A), Royal Blue (#1E40AF), Blue (#3B82F6), Light Blue (#60A5FA), White (#FFFFFF), Light Grey (#F8FAFC), Dark Grey (#334155).
- For Button width, use the native `fullWidth` variant/prop on <Button> rather than passing ad-hoc `w-*` classes.

message.spacing: Do not override Button spacing. Use standard Button sizes (sm, default, lg, icon) or the `fullWidth` variant.
message.default: Do not restyle Button. Use standard variants or compose with a wrapper component.
Use standard Badge variants. Do not hardcode custom styles or invent one-off variants.

shadcn/no-raw-colors.message: Do not use raw Tailwind colors. Register semantic variables in global CSS (src/index.css) to preserve design aesthetic.

shadcn/no-arbitrary-values.message: Do not use arbitrary bracket values. Use the design system scale.
